Every registered backend method requires a capability in backend/methods.json. scripts/check-backend-inventory.py checks method inventory and rejects raw version comparisons in its scanned QML callers. QML uses advertised capabilities or methods and retains a fallback when they are absent. Each watcher, poller and daemon needs one resource owner. Unix socket paths must fit the socket address limit.
